parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of mask propagation in arithmetic operations for NDDataRef objects. It ensures that if one operand lacks a mask, the existing mask is correctly handled or copied.

issues.description: The code could be slightly more readable by adding comments to explain the logic flow, especially around the mask handling conditions.
